name: io.github.kapella-hub/firekeep
description: Self-hosted memory and continuity for AI coding agents: persistent team memory, session continuity, environment awareness, coordination, replayable traces, and instruction-compliance measurement. One stdio gateway, 104 tools; bring your own server (any Docker host).

packageArguments.description: Run the local Firekeep MCP gateway (requires a one-time `firekeep join <code>` against your team's self-hosted server first).
